title: AI Readiness Assessment
titleTag: AI Readiness Assessment for Enterprise | Intermix AI
metaDescription: The Read phase of the Intermix Operating System — a structured readiness assessment across data, workflows, and organization.
cardOutcome: Know exactly where you stand before you spend a dollar on implementation.
headline: Know exactly where you stand before you spend a dollar on implementation.
body: Before any technology decision, we read your organization across three dimensions — data readiness, workflow readiness, and organizational readiness — and produce a clear, prioritized picture of where AI can realistically create value in the next 6 to 12 months. This is the entry point of the Operating System and the recommended first engagement for any organization without a prior AI initiative.
deliverables: Organizational readiness scorecard (skills, change capacity, executive sponsorship)
Top 5 highest-ROI opportunity shortlist with feasibility ratings, feeding directly into the Rank phase
outcomes: Replace guesswork with a documented, defensible readiness picture.
Avoid the most common cause of pilot failure: starting with the wrong use case.
Arrive at the Rank phase with a shortlist already scored by ROI and feasibility.

engagement.format: Stakeholder interviews, workflow mapping sessions, data environment review
engagement.team: 1 Intermix AI assessor, client-side data/IT liaison and 3-5 functional stakeholders

title: AI Strategy & Roadmap
titleTag: Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmap | Intermix AI
metaDescription: The Rank phase of the Intermix Operating System — a board-ready, ROI-ranked AI roadmap grounded in your operating model.
cardOutcome: Define where AI belongs in your operating model and your three-year roadmap.
headline: A three-year AI roadmap, ranked by what actually pays back first.
body: Most AI strategies are written by people who understand the technology but not the business, or the business but not the technology. We build strategy at the intersection — taking the opportunities surfaced in the Read phase and ranking them by ROI, feasibility, and risk, then sequencing them into a roadmap your board can actually approve.
deliverables: Enterprise AI opportunity map across all major business functions
Build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendation for each priority use case
Executive presentation deck for board and leadership alignment
outcomes: A defensible, board-ready AI roadmap replaces ad hoc pilot requests.
Budget is allocated to the highest-ranked opportunities first, not the loudest internal request.
Leadership alignment is established before any implementation spend begins.

engagement.format: Structured workshops with leadership + a dedicated strategy deliverable
engagement.team: 1-2 Intermix AI senior strategists, client-side executive sponsor and functional leads

title: AI Implementation
titleTag: Enterprise AI Implementation & Pilots | Intermix AI
metaDescription: The Run phase of the Intermix Operating System — working, production-ready AI pilots with automation built into delivery.
cardOutcome: Move from roadmap to a working, production-ready pilot — automated where it counts.
headline: From roadmap to a working, production-ready pilot — automated where it counts.
body: We build one to two working AI solutions against your highest-ranked use cases — not demos, but pilots designed to run in a real operational environment and produce evidence leadership can act on. When the top-ranked opportunity is a repetitive, high-volume workflow, the pilot is delivered as an automation by default — Intermix AI does not sell automation as a separate line item; it is simply how Run gets executed when the use case calls for it.
deliverables: 1-2 working AI pilots (e.g., reporting assistant, internal knowledgebase, workflow assistant, executive copilot, or a workflow automation where volume and repeatability justify it)
Integration plan for existing systems and data sources
Pilot performance report against defined success metrics
Go/no-go recommendation for the Rise phase
outcomes: Proof of value exists before broader budget is committed.
Technical feasibility is validated in your actual environment, not a vendor sandbox.
Leadership receives evidence-based go/no-go guidance rather than vendor promises.
High-volume, repetitive workflows are automated as part of delivery, recovering measurable team hours without a separate automation engagement.

engagement.format: Iterative build-test cycles with weekly stakeholder checkpoints
engagement.team: 1-2 Intermix AI implementation leads, client-side technical liaison

title: Executive AI Advisory
titleTag: Executive AI Advisory & Governance | Intermix AI
metaDescription: The Rise phase of the Intermix Operating System — ongoing executive AI advisory with governance built into every scale-up plan.
cardOutcome: Ongoing strategic counsel and governed scale-up for leadership navigating AI decisions.
headline: Governed scale-up and ongoing strategic counsel for AI leadership.
body: AI decisions don't stop after the first pilot. Executive AI Advisory is a standing relationship that governs the rise from proven pilot to enterprise-wide adoption — with security, data privacy, and responsible-AI guardrails built into the scale-up plan by default, not sold separately as a governance engagement. It also gives leadership a trusted, independent voice for evaluating new vendors, capabilities, and board questions as they arise.
deliverables: Governed scale-up plan covering security, access control, and responsible-AI guidelines for every system moving from pilot to production
Quarterly board-ready AI progress and governance reporting
outcomes: AI scales without creating unmanaged data, security, or compliance exposure.
Leadership gets an independent perspective, not a vendor's sales pitch.
Board and regulatory reporting stays current without consuming internal team bandwidth.
Strategic AI decisions are made with continuity, not in isolated one-off engagements.

engagement.format: Monthly sessions plus on-demand access, with governance review built into every quarterly cycle
engagement.team: 1 senior Intermix AI advisor, direct line to client executive sponsor and compliance/legal liaison
